name.pt-BR: Sobre a graça e o livre-arbítrio

description.en-US: Watkin Williams's English (SPCK, 1920) of Bernard's treatise on grace and free choice, addressed to William of St. Thierry: the preface and fourteen chapters (titled by number, because the OCR garbles Williams's chapter headings), with Williams's footnotes where the OCR keeps them legible.
description.pt-BR: A tradução inglesa de Watkin Williams (1920) do tratado de São Bernardo sobre a graça e o livre-arbítrio.

sources.edition: The Treatise of St. Bernard concerning Grace and Free Will, translated by Watkin Williams (London: SPCK, 1920), Translations of Christian Literature, Series IV.
sources.description: Djvu OCR cleaned by script, not proofread. Williams's introduction, synopsis and indexes are not imported; his footnotes are dropped, and a few note lines the OCR ran into the text may remain; the chapter headings are not given because the OCR garbles them.
sources.tierEvidence: Published in 1920, before 1931: public domain in the US.
